purpose: Bound repository working-set growth while separating static control law from mutable admission state.

admission.evidence: working-set admission is derived from the validated coordinator-state projection; a PR may also inherit working-set standing through a closing-keyword link to an admitted issue

maintenance.standing: author identity only; labels refine cohorts and never grant maintenance standing

control_plane.exemption: only when every changed file is a control-plane path; mixed changes require admission

evaluation_admission.evidence: closing-keyword link to an issue whose body declares ADMISSION_REQUESTED plus latest APPROVED review by an authorized actor

notes: Static policy remains on the default branch; mutable explicit admissions are stored on the persistent coordinator-state branch.
Admission determines working-set standing only. It does not ratify governance, approve code, or authorize merge.
The gate must resolve and receipt the exact coordinator-state commit used for each decision.
The gate fails closed when the ledger or materialized projection is missing, malformed, unsupported, or divergent.
Evaluation admission remains a separate evidence-producing lane and does not consume operator capacity.
